rules: CT-4: 0022/0023 stay reserved for BASE 6K; artifact technical files start at 0024.
CT-5: the lease holder assigns idx (max existing + 1) and when (greater than the maximum existing journal/applied timestamp). Never renumber, retime or replace an applied/released entry.
CT-6: BASE-first appends artifact entries after the fixed BASE prefix; ARTEFACTS-first is permitted without importing or applying 6K.
CT-7: freeze one journal order before first persistent use across the target release chain; record provenance for any reindex/retime of unpublished suffix metadata.
CT-8: qualify standalone delivery on fresh DB, baseline upgrade and rerun with only its own migrations before any combined delivery.
notes: idx/when are assigned by the integration writer at apply time; this file proposes content only and performs no numbering.
Applied/deployed state is unverified until an operator receipt.
SQL bytes and hashes are preserved from this proposal; the writer records the resulting hash.
